text: CudaMon requires: NVIDIA GPU visible current R session working NVML installation package installed native code compiled successfully GPU available, code still useful reference, produce samples.

title: Getting Started with CudaMon
text: simplest workflow starts sampler tied current R session. default, CudaMon samples per second includes descendant processes. can customize sampling interval limit collection specific device:
code: library(CudaMon)  sampler <- cm_start() sampler <- cm_start(     period = 0.5,     device_index = 0 )

title: Getting Started with CudaMon
text: sampler running, execute code want profile. Use cm_timestamp() record named events later appear vertical markers plot.
code: cm_timestamp(sampler, "initialization")  Sys.sleep(2)  cm_timestamp(sampler, "training")  Sys.sleep(2)  cm_timestamp(sampler, "evaluation")

title: Construct a CudaMon session object — CudaMonSession
text: device_metrics Data frame GPU device-level samples. Expected columns include: timestamp Sample timestamp UTC. sampler_pid Root process identifier tracked sampler. device_index Zero-based GPU device index. gpu_utilization_pct Percent sampling interval least one kernel executing GPU. activity ratio, measure saturated GPU cores . memory_utilization_pct Percent sampling interval global device memory read written . memory-controller activity, fraction GPU memory allocated. temperature_c GPU temperature degrees Celsius. power_usage_mw Instantaneous board power draw milliwatts. memory_used_bytes Bytes device memory currently allocated. memory_total_device_bytes Total bytes physical device memory available. compute_processes Data frame GPU process-level samples. Expected columns include: timestamp Sample timestamp UTC. sampler_pid Root process identifier tracked sampler. device_index Zero-based GPU device index. pid Process identifier reported NVML using GPU. tracked_pid Tracked process identifier filtering requested root process , optionally, descendants. is_root_pid Whether tracked_pid root process passed sampler. used_gpu_memory_bytes Bytes GPU memory allocated process sampled device, reported NVML. gpu_instance_id MIG GPU instance identifier, NA apply reported. compute_instance_id MIG compute instance identifier, NA apply reported. events Data frame event markers recorded sampling. paths Named list output paths. metadata Named list session metadata.

title: Start sampling NVML metrics to CSV files — cm_start
text: period Sampling interval seconds. pid Root process identifier, defaults current R session PID. include_descendants Whether include child processes pid. device_index Optional integer GPU index. NULL, query devices. log Optional log file written background sampler process. path_prefix Optional output path prefix. NULL, unique prefix generated automatically. Three files created: *_device_metrics.csv, *_compute_processes.csv, *_events.csv.
